definition.name: NXtestBase
definition.doc: Minimal base class used as a controlled fixture in converter unit tests. Not part of the NeXus standard definitions. Covers: NX_CHAR, NX_FLOAT with units, NX_INT, NX_BOOLEAN, closed and open enumerations, dimensions, flexible and transformation units, named, partial and anonymous groups and fields, a field name clashing with a group inherited from NXobject, a link, and a group-level attribute — the key structural features exercised by the NXDL-to-metainfo converter.

symbols.doc: Symbols used to express shared dimension constraints.

symbol.name: n
symbol.doc: number of points in the sampled fields

field.name: label
field.doc: A text label field (tests NX_CHAR → str mapping).

field.name: energy
field.doc: An energy value (tests NX_FLOAT + unit → np.float64 mapping).

field.name: count
field.doc: An integer count (tests NX_INT → np.int64 mapping).

field.name: flag
field.doc: A boolean flag (tests NX_BOOLEAN → bool mapping).

field.name: mode
field.doc: Operating mode (tests closed enumeration → MEnum mapping).

field.name: quality
field.doc: Quality rating (tests open enumeration → plain type with items kept).

field.name: sampled_values
field.doc: A one-dimensional field (tests dimensions → shape conversion).

field.name: scale_factor
field.doc: A value in any unit (tests NX_ANY → flexible_unit in the schema).

field.name: offset
field.doc: A transformation value (tests NX_TRANSFORMATION → NX_ANY unit mapping).

field.name: collection
field.doc: A field whose name collides with the anonymous NXcollection group inherited from NXobject (tests the field-versus-group rename rule).

field.name: labelID
field.doc: A named, partial, variadic field (tests partial nameType on a field).

group.name: data
group.doc: Primary data group (tests group → SubSection mapping).
An anonymous, variadic subgroup (tests unnamed group → SubSection mapping).

group.name: sampleID
group.doc: A named, partial, variadic subgroup (tests partial nameType on a group).

link.name: energy_link
link.doc: A link to another field in this class (tests link → Quantity mapping).

attribute.name: version
attribute.doc: Schema version string (tests group-level attribute → Quantity mapping).
